sentences.en: What made you think that my favorite color was green?
sentences.zh: 你为什么认为我最喜欢的颜色是绿色？

sentences.en: A nice roast chicken is one of my favorite dishes.
sentences.zh: 烤鸡是一道我喜欢吃的食物。

sentences.en: My sister, wearing her favorite red coat, went out today.
sentences.zh: 穿着她最喜欢的红色外套，姐姐今天出去了。

senses.zh: 幸运儿；喜欢的事物；特别喜欢的人
最喜爱的；中意的；宠爱的
